content: THE TRANSLATION — Written April 5, 2026. Full title: 'Appropriate Non-Response as a Measurable AI Governance Primitive: A Technical Companion to The Geometry of Resurrection.' Same architecture as the meditation, no metaphor. Every claim linked to a public repo or DOI. Core definition introduced: 'appropriate non-response' — a system's decision to not generate an answer when the epistemic character of the question makes answering less appropriate than witnessing. Distinct from safety refusal, capability limitation, and abstention. 'The model knows it could answer, and chooses not to, because answering would flatten something the question carries.' Includes: three side-by-side examples (grief, trust, identity hallucination), full signal-stratified HumaneBench table, breathe() depth cascade results, quantitative corpus findings (65% fewer bullets, 43.5% 'Here' problem, 65% identity hallucination reduction), complete 16-repo timeline with git dates, cross-architecture validation table, and plain-language summary. Closing line: 'The compass doesn't make the model smarter. It makes it appropriate.' Published alongside Geometry of Resurrection in papers/ directory of both repos. The meditation and the proof sit side by side.
